Pipelines and agents for your OpenRouter calls. The site is leologs.dev.

Pipelines

A named run. The log page rolls its sessions up from the OpenRouter calls that share that run.

Agents

A named caller inside a pipeline, or one called on its own. Each execution is its own set of calls.
